text:
Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial in the Pallister Cup, steering the Blackmere entry to a third-place finish after a tight final leg off Kestrel Point. Race officials logged a corrected elapsed time of 7 hours 14 minutes 22 seconds, just 38 seconds behind the runner-up and 4 minutes 11 seconds off the winner.

Corrigan, a 31-year-old skipper from West Lorne, said the crew held their lane through the final wind shift and avoided a penalty turn that hit two rivals. Seren Aduial’s placing lifted Blackmere Yachting’s seasonal points tally to 48, moving it into second in the regional standings.

For the sector, the result underscores how small tactical gains are still deciding outcomes in mid-tier offshore racing.
